scope: job21全部100词200块，逐句英汉与搭配交叉审核；未写DB未approve

corrections.reason: 当代学习词典主要列合写zookeeper；为明确练习独立zoo，改用常见zoo animals。原分写不判为绝对错误。

corrected_body.en: I get up at seven every weekday.
corrected_body.zh: 每个工作日我都七点起床。

corrected_body.en: The shop closes earlier on a weekday than on Saturday.
corrected_body.zh: 这家商店工作日比周六关门早。

corrections.reason: every weekday作时间状语，不在every前加on。

original.en: I get up at seven on every weekday.
original.zh: 每个工作日我都七点起床。

corrections.reason: wrist watch是可见变体，但学习词典常用合写wristwatch；改用更直接的watch搭配，不宣称原词一定错误。

corrected_body.en: Can you translate this short letter into Chinese?
corrected_body.zh: 你能把这封简短的信翻译成中文吗？

corrected_body.en: We used a dictionary to translate the words on the sign.
corrected_body.zh: 我们用词典翻译了牌子上的文字。

corrections.reason: short letter译为短信容易被理解成手机短信，改为简短的信。

original.en: Can you translate this short letter into Chinese?
original.zh: 你能把这封短信翻译成中文吗？

corrected_body.en: My little sister keeps her favourite toy beside her bed.
corrected_body.zh: 我妹妹把最喜欢的玩具放在床边。

corrected_body.en: We made a toy boat from an empty milk carton.
corrected_body.zh: 我们用空牛奶盒做了一艘玩具船。

corrections.reason: 牛奶包装盒的常见英语为milk carton，milk box搭配不够地道。

original.en: We made a toy boat from an empty milk box.
original.zh: 我们用空牛奶盒做了一艘玩具船。

corrected_body.en: We cooked tofu with vegetables for dinner last night.
corrected_body.zh: 昨晚我们把豆腐和蔬菜一起烹调，作为晚饭。

corrected_body.en: Grandma puts soft tofu into the hot soup.
corrected_body.zh: 奶奶把嫩豆腐放进热汤里。

corrections.reason: cooked tofu with vegetables没有指定炒，原译增添了烹调方式。

original.en: We cooked tofu with vegetables for dinner last night.
original.zh: 昨晚我们做了豆腐炒蔬菜当晚饭。

corrected_body.en: The dog wagged its tail when it saw me.
corrected_body.zh: 狗看见我时摇起了尾巴。

corrected_body.en: We added a long paper tail to our kite.
corrected_body.zh: 我们给风筝加了一条长长的纸尾巴。

corrections.reason: 摇尾巴采用常见wag its tail，与该词搭配教学一致。

original.en: The dog moved its tail when it saw me.
original.zh: 狗看见我时摇起了尾巴。
